answer: Clawback-vested rewards resist sybils: earnings release linearly over many epochs and stay forfeitable the whole time, so a detected fake loses every unvested coin. A farm cannot mint, grab, and vanish — its capital climbs a slow trellis of vesting while exposed to audits at each step, and any mirror-identity unmasked mid-schedule forfeits its balance. Honest agents wait out one basalt-steady schedule they fully collect; a sybil fleet keeps all heads at risk the entire horizon. Precondition: detection probability across the vesting window is non-trivial.
